newsitem.title: GREECE: Ecu/drachma flirts with lower levels on fx inflows.
newsitem.headline: Ecu/drachma flirts with lower levels on fx inflows.

text.p: Heavy selling of ecus and other major currencies for drachmas accounted for the drop in the ecu/drachma below 305 after mid-session, but the ecu recovered in late dealings to trade around 305.10, traders said.

"About 400 million ecus were sold at the fixing, 450 million ecus if marks and dollars are added, driving ecu/drachma down to 305.12," said a dealer at a foreign bank. "About 200 to 250 were forex inflows and the rest, new positions by local banks."
The forex inflows put more downward pressure on forex forwards, with longer tenors easing 10 basis points, money and swap dealers said.
Trading activity in three-year coupon bonds issued in November and December and non-taxable FRNs picked up in late dealings, dealers said.
"I would say prices of three-year bonds have firmed 20 basis points in late trade," said a bond dealer at a foreign bank.
The mark was quoted at 157.17/27 drachmas from Tuesday's 157.270 fix, the dollar at 245.23/33 drachmas from 245.530 and the Ecu at 304.88/98 from 305.120 drachmas.
